poc_requirements: Throughput guarantee: sustained 600 concurrent chat sessions; ~20k tokens/sec aggregate. Latency SLO: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 320ms for 64-token completions (end-to-end). Reserved GPU planning: baseline 8x H100 nodes with 20% buffer (target), failover to 4x A100-like nodes for cost-tier fallback. Tests: ramped load tests (step to 120% of target), 48h soak at 70% sustained, mixed workload (chat+rerank+embed). Metrics to capture: per-token compute ms, queueing delay, KV cache hit ratio, GPU utilization, tail latency by model version. SLA negotiation: uptime 99.95%, credits for p95 misses, defined rollback/fallback to smaller model variant. Observability: per-route tracing, token-level cost reporting, audit log for inference inputs. Acceptance: meet throughput & p95 for 72% of test windows and no critical errors during soak.
